name: BURE
source:
Our guy has special powers, which 1 person out of 30,000 in his world has. For his sufferings, he wants revenge on the world, but some girls will try to stop him. He can either capture and train the girls for revenge or not capture and chase them for love. If he wants love, he better watch out for his missing half.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公拥有特殊能力，在他的世界里，每三万人中只有一人具备这种能力。由于长期饱受痛苦，他想向世界复仇；但一些女孩会试图阻止他。

他可以为了复仇捕获并训练女孩，也可以不去捕获她们，转而追求爱情。如果想获得爱情，就必须当心自己缺失的另一半。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li’s Fun House[/url]]
